#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the unchanged oracle and a frozen two-header geometry diagnostic.

Invoke under the shared cab-local-measurement.lock flock. No CMake reconfigure,
source repository mutation, acceptance-test edit, affinity or priority change.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import shlex
import shutil
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path('/workspace/scratch/2a8bfb39dc42')
OUT = ROOT / 'geometry8b-probe'
BASE = ROOT / 'chimera'
CANDIDATE = ROOT / 'chimera-geometry8b-probe'
CACHE = ROOT / 'build-candidate'
BASE_SHA = '8097ec69594ff728164c77f59e9ea1e39e384643'
LOCK = ROOT / 'cab-local-measurement.lock'
receipt = {'schema': 1, 'complete': False, 'commands': [], 'objects': [],
           'diagnostic_only': True, 'base_sha': BASE_SHA,
           'shared_exclusive_flock': str(LOCK), 'started_epoch': time.time()}

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def capture(command, cwd=None):
    return subprocess.check_output(command, cwd=cwd, text=True, timeout=60).strip()

def save():
    (OUT / 'build-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')

def run(command, log, timeout):
    record = {'command': [str(arg) for arg in command], 'cwd': str(OUT), 'log': log,
              'timeout_seconds': timeout, 'started_epoch': time.time()}
    receipt['commands'].append(record); save()
    try:
        with (OUT / log).open('wb') as stream:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=OUT, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
        record['returncode'] = result.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        record['returncode'] = 124
        record['timed_out'] = True
        raise
    finally:
        record['seconds'] = time.time() - record['started_epoch']; save()
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{log} failed with exit {result.returncode}')
    print(f'COMPLETE {log} seconds={record["seconds"]:.3f}', flush=True)

def source_state(source):
    names = capture(['git', 'ls-files', 'Source', 'Tests'], source).splitlines()
    return {'head': capture(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], source),
            'tree': capture(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'], source),
            'tracked_changes': capture(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'HEAD'], source).splitlines(),
            'files': [{'path': name, 'sha256': sha(source / name)} for name in names]}

try:
    # flock exports no standard indicator; require an exclusive flock record on
    # the exact shared inode. The invocation itself uses flock as the parent.
    inode = str(LOCK.stat().st_ino)
    lock_lines = Path('/proc/locks').read_text().splitlines()
    if not any('FLOCK' in line and 'WRITE' in line and line.split()[5].split(':')[-1] == inode
               for line in lock_lines if len(line.split()) > 5):
        raise RuntimeError('Shared exclusive measurement flock is not held')
    receipt['compiler'] = capture(['/usr/bin/c++', '--version']).splitlines()[0]
    receipt['platform'] = platform.platform()
    receipt['cpu'] = capture(['lscpu'])
    receipt['process_context'] = {'affinity_observed': sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),
                                  'nice_observed': os.getpriority(os.PRIO_PROCESS, 0)}
    cache_lines = (CACHE / 'CMakeCache.txt').read_text().splitlines()
    receipt['cache_options'] = {line.split(':', 1)[0]: line.split('=', 1)[1]
        for line in cache_lines if '=' in line and line.startswith((
            'CMAKE_HOME_DIRECTORY:', 'CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE:', 'CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER:',
            'FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_JUCE:'))}
    if receipt['cache_options'].get('CMAKE_HOME_DIRECTORY') != str(BASE):
        raise RuntimeError('JUCE object cache belongs to an unexpected source directory')
    receipt['juce_source_sha'] = capture(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], ROOT / 'juce-src')
    if receipt['juce_source_sha'] != 'd6181bde38d858c283c3b7bf699ce6340c050b5d':
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected JUCE source revision')
    receipt['source_before'] = {label: source_state(source) for label, source in
                                [('reference', BASE), ('candidate', CANDIDATE)]}
    if any(state['head'] != BASE_SHA for state in receipt['source_before'].values()):
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected source HEAD')
    if receipt['source_before']['reference']['tracked_changes']:
        raise RuntimeError('Reference has tracked source changes')
    if receipt['source_before']['candidate']['tracked_changes'] != ['Source/ModeledCabConvolution.h']:
        raise RuntimeError('Candidate overlay is not exactly the geometry header')
    oracle_name = 'Tests/CabRealtimeRegressionTests.cpp'
    if sha(BASE / oracle_name) != sha(CANDIDATE / oracle_name):
        raise RuntimeError('The existing acceptance oracle was changed')
    patch = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--binary', 'HEAD'], cwd=CANDIDATE, timeout=60)
    (OUT / 'candidate-overlay.diff').write_bytes(patch)
    receipt['overlay_sha256'] = sha(OUT / 'candidate-overlay.diff')
    for label, source in [('reference', BASE), ('candidate', CANDIDATE)]:
        target = OUT / label; target.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for name in ['ModeledCabConvolution.h', 'CabRealtimeProfile.h']:
            shutil.copyfile(source / 'Source' / name, target / name)
    lines = capture(['ninja', '-t', 'commands', 'ChimeraOriginalCabRealtimeTests'], CACHE).splitlines()
    compile_line = next(line for line in lines if ' -c ' in line and '/Tests/CabRealtimeRegressionTests.cpp' in line)
    link_line = next(line for line in lines if line.startswith(': && ') and 'CabRealtimeRegressionTests.cpp.o' in line)
    receipt['original_compile_command'] = compile_line
    receipt['original_link_command'] = link_line
    receipt['cached_module_compile_commands'] = [line for line in lines
        if ' -c ' in line and '/juce-src/modules/' in line and '/Tests/' not in line]
    arguments = shlex.split(compile_line)
    common = []; skip = False
    for index, argument in enumerate(arguments):
        if skip:
            skip = False; continue
        if argument in ('-MD',):
            continue
        if argument in ('-MT', '-MF', '-o', '-c'):
            skip = True; continue
        if argument == '-I' + str(BASE / 'Source'):
            argument = '-I' + str(CANDIDATE / 'Source')
        common.append(argument)
    link_arguments = shlex.split(link_line)
    object_dir = OUT / 'juce-objects'; object_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    objects = []
    for argument in link_arguments:
        if argument.endswith('.o') and 'CabRealtimeRegressionTests.cpp.o' not in argument:
            source = CACHE / argument
            destination = object_dir / source.name
            shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
            if sha(source) != sha(destination):
                raise RuntimeError('Cached module copy changed bytes')
            receipt['objects'].append({'source': str(source), 'local_copy': str(destination),
                                       'sha256': sha(destination), 'bytes': destination.stat().st_size})
            objects.append(destination)
    if len(objects) != 5:
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected JUCE cached-module link set')
    protocol = {'diagnostic_only': True, 'includes_worker_or_fade_wrapper': False,
                'source_base_sha': BASE_SHA, 'geometry': {'A': 'B<=128: N4B/segment3B/stride3; else N2B/B/1',
                    'B': 'B<=64: N8B/segment7B/stride7; else unchanged'},
                'rates': [48000, 96000], 'blocks': [32, 64, 128], 'channels': [1, 2],
                'kernel_working_sets': [6, 9], 'shared_prepared_responses': {'6': 2, '9': 3},
                'case_order': 'rate, then block, then channels, then kernels; ascending',
                'batch_order_per_case': 'ABBABAAB', 'warm_callbacks_per_batch': 512,
                'measured_callbacks_per_batch': 1600, 'total_cases': 24, 'total_batches': 192,
                'total_measured_callbacks': 307200, 'total_warm_callbacks': 98304,
                'total_probe_timeout_seconds': 180, 'p50_sorted_index': 800, 'p99_sorted_index': 1584,
                'ir_samples': 'ceil(sample_rate * .085), deterministic dense decaying FIR with last tap preserved',
                'input': 'fixed 4096 sample pattern; independent offsets per kernel/channel; identical per batch',
                'timed_interval': 'all kernels: forward FFT, pack, spectral MAC, inverse FFT, overlap',
                'untimed_work': 'construction, reset, input fill, output consumption, CSV writing',
                'affinity_priority': 'observed only; unchanged', 'reruns': 'none; output refuses overwrite'}
    (OUT / 'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(protocol, indent=2) + '\n')
    save()
    for name, source in [('oracle', CANDIDATE / oracle_name), ('kernel-benchmark', OUT / 'kernel_benchmark.cpp')]:
        obj = OUT / (name + '.o'); exe = OUT / name
        run([*common, '-c', source, '-o', obj], name + '-compile.log', 300)
        run(['/usr/bin/c++', '-O3', '-DNDEBUG', obj, *objects, '-o', exe, '-lrt', '-ldl', '-lpthread'],
            name + '-link.log', 120)
        receipt[name] = {'path': str(exe), 'sha256': sha(exe), 'source_sha256': sha(source)}
    run([OUT / 'oracle'], 'oracle.log', 120)
    text = (OUT / 'oracle.log').read_text()
    required = ['PASS CAB realtime equivalence routes=144 ', 'prepared_model_routes=108 ',
                'modeled_juce_loaders=0 ', 'reset_residual=0 ', 'latency=0 ',
                'chunks=fixed,1,17,63,max,3 ', 'six_mic_routes=8 ',
                'six_mic_oracle=direct_FIR ', 'worker_cases=stale,six_ready,reuse fade_ms=50']
    if any(token not in text for token in required):
        raise RuntimeError('Missing unchanged oracle coverage record')
    receipt['source_after'] = {label: source_state(source) for label, source in
                               [('reference', BASE), ('candidate', CANDIDATE)]}
    if receipt['source_before'] != receipt['source_after']:
        raise RuntimeError('Source changed during build/oracle')
    receipt['complete'] = True
    print(text.strip(), flush=True)
finally:
    receipt['finished_epoch'] = time.time()
    save()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run the one predeclared fixed probe, retaining every failure and partial file."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
receipt_path = OUT / 'measurement-receipt.json'
if receipt_path.exists():
    raise SystemExit('A measurement receipt already exists; refusing a second run')
build = json.loads((OUT / 'build-receipt.json').read_text())
if not build['complete']:
    raise SystemExit('The fixed build/oracle evidence is incomplete')
binary = OUT / 'kernel-benchmark'
digest = hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
if digest != build['kernel-benchmark']['sha256']:
    raise SystemExit('The benchmark binary changed since its recorded build')
lock = OUT.parent / 'cab-local-measurement.lock'
inode = str(lock.stat().st_ino)
if not any('FLOCK' in line and 'WRITE' in line and line.split()[5].split(':')[-1] == inode
           for line in Path('/proc/locks').read_text().splitlines() if len(line.split()) > 5):
    raise SystemExit('The exclusive measurement flock is not held')
receipt = {'complete': False, 'diagnostic_only': True, 'command': [str(binary), str(OUT / 'timings')],
           'cwd': str(OUT), 'timeout_seconds': 180, 'binary_before_sha256': digest,
           'started_epoch': time.time(), 'started_monotonic': time.monotonic(),
           'affinity_observed': sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)), 'nice_observed': os.getpriority(os.PRIO_PROCESS, 0),
           'shared_exclusive_flock': str(lock), 'number_of_attempts': 1}
receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
try:
    with (OUT / 'benchmark-console.log').open('wb') as output:
        process = subprocess.run(receipt['command'], cwd=OUT, stdout=output,
                                 stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=180)
    receipt['returncode'] = process.returncode
    text = (OUT / 'benchmark-console.log').read_text()
    marker = ('PROBE_COMPLETE cases=24 batches=192 callbacks=307200 warm_callbacks=98304 '
              'order=ABBABAAB control_output_hashes=matched diagnostic_only=1')
    receipt['complete'] = process.returncode == 0 and marker in text
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    receipt['returncode'] = 124
    receipt['timed_out'] = True
finally:
    receipt['seconds'] = time.monotonic() - receipt['started_monotonic']
    receipt['finished_epoch'] = time.time()
    receipt['binary_after_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    receipt['complete'] &= receipt['binary_after_sha256'] == digest
    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
    print((OUT / 'benchmark-console.log').read_text(), end='', flush=True)
    print('MEASUREMENT_RECEIPT ' + json.dumps({k: receipt[k] for k in ('complete', 'returncode', 'seconds')}), flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if receipt['complete'] else 1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only verification and summary of the one retained local geometry probe."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
import csv
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import math
import statistics
import subprocess

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TIMINGS = OUT / 'timings'
ORDER = 'ABBABAAB'

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)

def equal(actual, expected):
    return math.isclose(float(actual), float(expected), rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-10)

def read_csv(path):
    with path.open(newline='') as stream:
        return list(csv.DictReader(stream))

build = json.loads((OUT / 'build-receipt.json').read_text())
measurement = json.loads((OUT / 'measurement-receipt.json').read_text())
protocol = json.loads((OUT / 'protocol.json').read_text())
require(build['complete'] and measurement['complete'] and measurement['returncode'] == 0,
        'Build/oracle/measurement is not complete')
require(sha(OUT / 'kernel-benchmark') == measurement['binary_before_sha256']
        == measurement['binary_after_sha256'] == build['kernel-benchmark']['sha256'], 'Binary mismatch')
require(sha(OUT / 'candidate-overlay.diff') == build['overlay_sha256'], 'Patch hash mismatch')
require(all(sha(Path(obj['local_copy'])) == obj['sha256'] for obj in build['objects']), 'Cached object copy changed')
symbols = subprocess.check_output(['nm', '-C', '--defined-only', str(OUT / 'kernel-benchmark')], text=True)
fft_symbols = [line for line in symbols.splitlines() if 'FFT::EngineImpl<' in line or '::fftFallback' in line]
require(fft_symbols and all('FFTFallback' in line or '::fftFallback' in line for line in fft_symbols),
        'Unexpected FFT engine symbol set')
(OUT / 'fft-backend-symbols.txt').write_text('\n'.join(fft_symbols) + '\n')
sources = {'reference': OUT.parent / 'chimera', 'candidate': OUT.parent / 'chimera-geometry8b-probe'}
for label, state in build['source_after'].items():
    require(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=sources[label], text=True).strip()
            == build['base_sha'], 'Source HEAD changed')
    require(all(sha(sources[label] / entry['path']) == entry['sha256'] for entry in state['files']),
            'Source bytes changed after correctness')
    require(sha(OUT / label / 'ModeledCabConvolution.h') == sha(sources[label] / 'Source/ModeledCabConvolution.h'),
            'Frozen benchmark header differs from checked source')

rows = read_csv(TIMINGS / 'batches.csv')
expected_cases = ['-'.join(map(str, case)) for case in itertools.product(
    (48000, 96000), (32, 64, 128), (1, 2), (6, 9))]
require(len(rows) == 192, 'Batch population is not 192')
require([row['case'] for row in rows[::8]] == expected_cases, 'Fixed case order changed')
per_case = defaultdict(list)
raw_paths, raw_ledger = set(), []
for position, row in enumerate(rows):
    case = expected_cases[position // 8]
    batch = position % 8 + 1
    variant = ORDER[batch - 1]
    require(row['case'] == case and int(row['batch']) == batch and row['variant'] == variant,
            'Fixed batch order changed')
    require(int(row['warm_callbacks']) == 512 and int(row['measured_callbacks']) == 1600,
            'Callback population changed')
    rate, block, channels, kernels = map(int, case.split('-'))
    require(all(int(row[key]) == value for key, value in zip(
        ('rate', 'block', 'channels', 'kernels', 'responses'), (rate, block, channels, kernels, kernels // 3))),
        'Summary configuration changed')
    path = TIMINGS / f'{case}-{batch}-{variant}.csv'
    samples = read_csv(path)
    require(len(samples) == 1600, 'Missing raw callbacks')
    durations = []
    for index, sample in enumerate(samples):
        require(sample['case'] == case and sample['batch'] == str(batch) and sample['variant'] == variant
                and sample['callback_index'] == str(index), 'Raw callback identity changed')
        elapsed = int(sample['wall_ns'])
        require(elapsed >= 0, 'Negative raw elapsed time')
        durations.append(elapsed)
    ordered = sorted(durations)
    for field, expected in [('p50_us', ordered[800] / 1000), ('p99_us', ordered[1584] / 1000),
                            ('max_us', ordered[-1] / 1000), ('mean_us', statistics.mean(durations) / 1000)]:
        require(equal(row[field], expected), f'{case}/{batch}: {field} differs from raw samples')
    raw_paths.add(path.name)
    raw_ledger.append({'path': str(path.relative_to(OUT)), 'sha256': sha(path),
                       'callbacks': len(samples), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size})
    per_case[case].append(row)
require({path.name for path in TIMINGS.glob('*.csv')} == raw_paths | {'batches.csv', 'geometry.csv'},
        'Missing or extra CSV files')

geometry = read_csv(TIMINGS / 'geometry.csv')
require(len(geometry) == 48 and len({(r['case'], r['variant']) for r in geometry}) == 48,
        'Geometry ledger population mismatch')
geometry_map = {(r['case'], r['variant']): r for r in geometry}
cases = []
for name in expected_cases:
    batches = per_case[name]
    rate, block, channels, kernels = map(int, name.split('-'))
    variants = {}
    for variant in 'AB':
        selected = [r for r in batches if r['variant'] == variant]
        require(len({row['output_hash'] for row in selected}) == 1, 'Repeated output hash differs')
        variants[variant] = {'batch_numbers': [int(r['batch']) for r in selected],
            'median_batch_p50_us': statistics.median(float(r['p50_us']) for r in selected),
            'median_batch_p99_us': statistics.median(float(r['p99_us']) for r in selected),
            'median_batch_mean_us': statistics.median(float(r['mean_us']) for r in selected),

# Local 8B convolution geometry probe

**Decision: do not integrate this geometry on the strength of this probe.** The isolated candidate passed the unchanged audio oracle, but it increased full-kernel median cost in all 16 changed configurations on this Linux/GCC/JUCE backend. No native Windows or macOS speedup is established.

## Exact scope and correctness

Base source: `8097ec69594ff728164c77f59e9ea1e39e384643`. Candidate patch SHA-256: `a0359eb8b128a89cdde9888217c6fae7cb93156cb7c09c3ce3b70e19ddfeaecb`. Only `Source/ModeledCabConvolution.h` differs, selecting FFT=8B, IR segment=7B and ring stride=7 for rounded blocks through 64. The 128-sample and larger geometries, arithmetic loop, SIMD branches, worker, sample population, latency and acceptance tolerances remain unchanged.

For a B-sample input block and a 7B-sample IR partition, linear convolution has 8B−1 samples and fits the 8B FFT. The existing generic overlap/ring code therefore remains mathematically applicable. The actual unchanged regression executable also passed once:

```text
PASS CAB realtime equivalence routes=144 models=v1,v2,v3,userIR prepared_model_routes=108 modeled_juce_loaders=0 uniform_residual=1.49012e-08 impulse_residual=7.45058e-09 reset_residual=0 latency=0 chunks=fixed,1,17,63,max,3 mic_post_routes=18 mic_post_residual=0 reprepare_routes=4 reprepare_residual=0 six_mic_routes=8 six_mic_residual=4.84288e-08 six_mic_oracle=direct_FIR worker_cases=stale,six_ready,reuse fade_ms=50
```

The test source SHA-256 is `fd07d6fb300484671800ad47d81475ff674d9a06f27787d1e7b979c38b1ac8bd`. No acceptance test was edited. The 144-route uniform-reference/absolute-impulse checks retain the 3e-6 limit, partial chunks and full IR tail; the eight direct-FIR six-mic cases retain stale response rejection, six ready publications, reused responses and 50 ms serial fades.

## Fixed measurement protocol

The one executable contains frozen baseline and candidate production headers in separate namespaces, linked to identical copied JUCE module objects. It uses the original GCC 13.3 Release flags, without added fast-math, FMA, forced SSE or architecture options. All builds, the single oracle execution and the single benchmark held the shared exclusive local measurement lock. Observed process nice was 0 and affinity covered CPUs 0–8; neither was changed.

Host: Linux 6.18.44 x86-64, AMD EPYC 9V74, GCC 13.3. JUCE source is pinned to d6181bde38d858c283c3b7bf699ce6340c050b5d. Binary symbols contain only the JUCE FFTFallback engine registration (`fft-backend-symbols.txt`). This does not reproduce Apple vDSP or native MSVC code generation.

There are 24 configurations: 48/96 kHz × 32/64/128 samples × mono/stereo × 6/9 active kernels. Six kernels have two immutable shared Prepared responses; nine have three. Every kernel has independent FFT state and history. Responses span the full 85 ms interval, with deterministic dense decaying samples and a nonzero last tap. Each batch starts with reset and 512 warm callbacks, followed by 1,600 measured callbacks. The fixed order is A B B A B A A B for every case.

The timer surrounds all kernels’ forward transforms, spectral packing/MAC, inverse transforms and overlap handling. Input copying, construction/reset, output checking and CSV writes are outside. No worker, filters or publication/fade wrapper is included; this is a complete-convolution microprobe and cannot replace the CAB acceptance test.

All 192 batches, 307,200 measured callbacks and 98,304 warm callbacks finished in 36.428 seconds. Every raw callback, fixed ordering and reported quantile was verified. Repeated deterministic outputs had matching hashes; baseline/candidate 128-sample control hashes also matched. No sample or failed run was discarded, and no rerun occurred.

## Interpretation and limits

The unchanged 128-sample control has p50 changes from about −1.01% to +0.44%. Its p99 changes range from −12.96% to +16.83%, showing that tail timing remains noisy on this host. Every changed case increased median p50, and 64 of 64 adjacent comparisons at 32/64 samples increased p50. The 64-sample regression is roughly 72–134%, far beyond the unchanged control’s median drift. Two 96 kHz/32 mono p99 comparisons improved despite their median regressions; those observations are retained in the table.

At 96 kHz, the changed geometry reduces logical complex-bin MAC work by roughly 12–15%, while nearly doubling the input spectral-ring storage and doubling FFT length. The complete-kernel measurements show that the operation-count saving is insufficient on this backend. The probe does not contain separate stage clocks, so it does not causally isolate FFT work, overlap work, memory traffic or other execution costs.

Apple vDSP and native MSVC can have a different tradeoff. This local result provides a clear no-go for adopting the geometry as a cross-platform optimization without contrary native evidence; it is not proof that macOS vDSP must regress. No additional local tuning or repeat run is warranted by these results.
